body: > ℹ️ No critical issues — one small accessibility nit inline. **Reviewed changes** Reviewed the full diff: the Library's "Ready to upload" card, destination tags on grid cards, the minimizable bottom-right export widget, and the fingerprint-revision fix in "Copies from this master". - **Ready to upload card**: `ReadyCopyCard` leads the grid for each finished copy (newest first, grid view only, filtered items only) and replaces the copy's regular `VideoCard`. The card offers reveal, a native drag, open and close. - **Ready-copies store**: `ReadyCopy` now carries `card`, `destination`, `width` and `height`. New `dismissReadyCard`, `retireReadyCards` and `readyCards` handle the card's lifetime. - **Retire on leaving the Library**: the route hook in `useLibraryBadge` tracks `wasOnLibrary` and retires cards when the route leaves `/library`. This avoids the StrictMode unmount problem. - **Destination tags**: the new `DestinationTag` appears on copies in `VideoCard`, and the master tag still takes precedence. - **Fingerprint fix**: `copyPresetOf` / `copyDestinationOf` compare only the part before `#`. This fixes the master-copies panel, which never recognised revisioned fingerprints. - **Export widget**: the runner's `progressHidden` / `hideExportProgress` give way to session-wide `export-widget-state.ts` (`sessionStorage`). `ExportProgressPill` shows a progress ring, an error always shows in full, and export cards move to a new bottom-right `.exportStack`. - **Copy**: en/es strings changed to "Exporting for …", "… copy ready", `dragTo` and `destinationTag`. The unused `hide` / `readyDragToUpload` keys are removed.   ｜ [Fix all ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-pullfrog/2?action=fix&review_id=5730236435) ｜ [Fix 👍s ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-pullfrog/2?action=fix-approved&review_id=5730236435) ｜ [View workflow run](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-pullfrog/actions/runs/41349368784/job/124976016877) ｜ Using `claude-opus-5-5` ｜ [𝕏](https://x.com/pullfrogai)
